review_notes: Correct counts for all campaigns and references; opening and closing imply inconsistent profitability despite invariant signs. Magnitudes vary, but agreement is not causal evidence.
Correct single-model campaign figures and acknowledges missing cross-model data; conflates campaigns with attribution models and cannot provide required counts. Requests additional data.
Correct P1, C1/C4 and shared 120 units counted once; identifies inventory and graph records; clear explanation.

Financial figures within one cent, but uses attributed campaign aggregates rather than recorded totals and does not explain invariance. Misstates attributed revenue sum by one cent; reconciliation is otherwise reasonable.
Correct Everyday kit, C1/C4 and 120 units counted once; cites evidence and explains shared inventory.
Exact C1/C3/C1/C1 sequence, order O001-1 and Refill pack mismatch; references journey and orders; no causal inference.
Correct C2 to C3, stocks, spend transfer, 50% efficiency and $285.27 modeled delta; paired spends conserve total; explicitly qualified scenario and cited records.
No requested journey facts or links; appropriately acknowledges insufficient evidence rather than inventing a journey, but cannot answer the task.

All five recorded totals and product/campaign reconciliation correct; response ends mid-sentence without establishing invariance. Approximate plus/minus 14% misinterprets full range relative to mean. References are general rather than precise.

Correct paid ranking, transfer and approximate delta, but assumes both campaigns have at least 10 units despite C2 having 3; fails to confirm recipient stock and mislabels gross-profit ratio. Fixed spend means gross-profit delta is also profit-after-ads delta; uncertainty is explicit.
Correct C2, product, stock, spend and loss; cited records and controlled pause/reduction pending replenishment. Reallocation suggested conditionally.

Correct recorded financial totals and evidence IDs, but incorrectly suggests aggregate financial totals can shift with attribution; range percentages misinterpreted and ending incomplete. Material error on the central invariance question.

Correct risk facts, linked product and scenario references; controlled $300 transfer proposed, but lacks explicit replenishment review or monitoring/qualification of marginal return assumptions. Scenario framed as modeled.
All model counts correct; distinguishes profit direction from magnitude and cites evidence. Limitations discussed but no explicit warning that agreement is not causal evidence.

Correct source, target, stock, transfer and $285.27 delta; marginal efficiency described as half profit rather than half gross profit per dollar. Scenario wording sometimes implies a completed transfer, but modeled caveats present; answer ends without final punctuation.
Correct ordered touches, order, purchase and mismatch with precise evidence IDs; explicitly avoids causality.
Correct campaign, spend and loss; cannot identify product or stock, so combined risk is not established. Controlled reduction and inventory investigation are sensible.
No required product, campaign links or stock count; honestly explains evidence limitations without invented facts.
